benchmark_name: MotionIQ End-to-End Real-Time Feedback Latency Breakdown

test_environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8GB VRAM)
test_environment.camera: 1080p 60fps Monocular RGB Webcam (USB 3.0, calibrated at 30fps capture)

methodology.clock_synchronization: Browser performance.now() timestamps stamped into WebSocket payload, round-trip measured at UI render callback.

stage_1_camera_frame_capture.description: Webcam sensor exposure, hardware DMA buffer transfer, and MediaStreamTrack frame delivery

stage_2_browser_pose_estimation.description: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (BlazePose Lite / Full) WebGL GPU inference in Chrome Web Worker
stage_2_browser_pose_estimation.bottleneck: WASM/WebGL shader execution and tensor copy

stage_3_websocket_client_to_backend.description: JSON serialization of 33 normalized landmarks and TCP loopback WebSocket transit
stage_3_websocket_client_to_backend.bottleneck: V8 JSON.stringify and local TCP socket buffer

stage_4_backend_processing.description: FastAPI async handler: Kalman pose smoothing, 3D torso view estimation, HMM rep state machine, form rule evaluation, and uncertainty gating
stage_4_backend_processing.bottleneck: Kalman 33-point covariance propagation and rule evaluation

stage_5_websocket_backend_to_client.description: JSON serialization of AssessmentResult and WebSocket transmission back to browser
stage_5_websocket_backend_to_client.bottleneck: Python ujson serialization and socket transit

stage_6_frontend_canvas_render.description: Client state update, HUD metric diffing, and HTML5 2D Canvas skeleton re-render
stage_6_frontend_canvas_render.bottleneck: requestAnimationFrame synchronization and 2D canvas draw operations

overall_summary.distinction_note: Previous benchmark claimed 520 FPS (1.92 ms) by measuring isolated CPU array calculations on pre-extracted landmarks. True physical end-to-end feedback loop requires 57.0 ms median (17.5 FPS).

hardware_scaling_comparison.hardware_tier: Mid-Range Laptop (Intel Iris Xe, i5-11th Gen)
